title: Ties in Function Field Prime Races
summary: The function field analogue of Chebyshev's bias was first studied by Cha. In this paper, we study *ties* in this race, namely collections of distinct congruence classes $c_1, \dots, c_k \in (\mathbb{F}_q[T] / m)^\times$ for which $$π(N; m, c_1) = π(N; m, c_2) = \dots = π(N; m, c_k)$$ holds for infinitely many $N$. We provide infinitely many examples of $(m, c_1, \dots, c_k)$ for which the tie holds whenever $N$ satisfies certain congruence conditions.
